title: Besiktas and CSKA Moscow keen on loan move for Everton's Cenk Tosun
trail: Cenk Tosun has said he is open to a return to Besiktas after his former club joined CSKA Moscow in attempting to sign the Everton striker
body: Cenk Tosun has said he is open to a return to Besiktas after his former club joined CSKA Moscow in attempting to sign the Everton striker. Tosun is surplus to requirements under Carlo Ancelotti and has not featured in Everton’s past two matchday squads despite a lack of cover for Dominic Calvert-Lewin. The Turkey international, who joined Everton from Besiktas three years ago in a deal rising to £27m, has made seven club appearances in all competitions this season. CSKA and Besiktas have registered interest in a loan for the 29-year-old, who remains under contract until 2022, and he is keen on a return to Istanbul. Tosun told NTV Spor: “If Everton and Besiktas have an agreement, I am ready to wear the black and white jersey again. I would like to contribute to Besiktas until the end of the season. If Everton approves the transfer, it will not be a problem for me.” Yannick Bolasie’s Everton career is effectively over after he joined Middlesbrough on loan until the end of the season. The 31-year-old winger, who cost £25m from Crystal Palace in 2016, is out of contract this summer and has had loans at Aston Villa, Anderlecht and Sporting since suffering a serious knee injury against Manchester United in December 2016.
